notes:
• The offer now lives inside the customer's ticket: open a ticket and the strip under the header switches between 🧾 Ticket · 📠 Scan · 🃏 Cards · ✏️ Draft · 📄 Offer sheet — all for that customer. ← Tickets goes back to the board
• The ticket opens as a full page (Cancel / Done at the top, Close at the bottom) and its offer is loaded for you
• The app opens on Tickets; the separate Offer creator tab is hidden — use Quick offer (no ticket) on the Tickets tab for offers without a customer ticket, or turn the tab back on in Settings → This PC
